claim_boundary: binding rule and measured per-phase read cycles under the proposal's whole-row striping; a FAIL means the model's t_read (words / macros) is not realisable by whole-row ownership, not that the binding is wrong

rule.word_order: k-outer: address = base + block * rows_here + row_index
rule.dense: LPT per phase: fewest phase words, then most free depth, then lowest id
rule.experts: expert j (die id order): w1|w3 rows on (j mod floor(N/1152))*1152 + r, w2 rows on (j mod floor(N/1280))*1280 + r

priced.note: lm_head (BF16, not on a layer die) keeps the model's t_read
